title: Research: exact joint connector read and transfer synthesis
body:
The retained PR2208 compiler commits to one minimum-read decomposition before optimizing root transfers. This package adds an exact graph that optimizes transfers across all minimum-read decompositions for a fixed paired source word and fixed F2 colors, with every child at physical z0 and both arbitrary dirty roots restored.

It proves the known reviewer fixture has optimum 6 transfers at 14 reads (the predecessor compiler uses 10); the 6-transfer witness itself remains credited to that reviewer. Three additional fixtures certify 12 transfers at 15/33/33 reads. A separate physical-root layered engine reconstructs every state below each optimum and matches the complete canonical frontier digest and layer sizes. It also finds an accepting optimum layer. This is a reusable complete synthesis reduction, not a claim of a newly discovered 6-transfer word.

Package: `research/joint-connector-read-synthesis/`. Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Original card connector-alphabet-change is explicitly changed to the PR2208 solver handoff. Exact source SHA256/Git-blob pins retain conorholds PR2208 at `28480ef4fdb4caeab89765ea56595bf1f6f37688`, compiler, regression fixture and Apache license; Ross Richardson's connector lineage and adjacent PR1887/2182 work are credited.

Validation: registered optimized Python 3.12.14 replay PASS; 2,112 dense arbitrary-dirty basis columns forward/inverse, five semantic controls; Git-free positive replay and three actual receipt/source/algorithm corruptions rejected. Parent agent reviewed the complete written reduction with no findings. `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-connector-read-synthesis` reproduces. No hosted CI or full selected cold replay claimed.

The solver rejects 250,000-state overflow rather than emitting a truncated optimum. No claim for PR2208's larger n9/n12 walks, unrestricted source order/colors, weighted shear prices, read/transfer tradeoffs, selected-supplier admission, physical runtime, or new kappa. Full cost comparison charges the same children and two dirty rows, with the first-fixture delta `-4*tau + Delta(admission+preparation+emission)`.

Final overlap search used 726 open PRs and 1,210 Discussion records with complete pagination; exact query found only PR2208 and this package, not a novelty guarantee. Current main and PR2208 head were freshly rechecked. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review claimed. Status: completed, focused result released for review.
